about: What the door offers a person who has no key. Read at runtime, never compiled in: edit this file, or point WS_DOOR_OPTIONS at another, and the offer changes. Which keyed options stay is Pedro's pick; these are the candidates whose free terms were read on the providers' own pages on 2026-11-04.

suggestions.why: Measured 2026-11-04 on an 8 GB card: the law took 20 of 20 of the door's shaped asks, 1 to 3 s an answer.
For smaller cards, or memory alone: the law took 19 of 20, under 2 s an answer on a card.

local.about: Suggestions only: the check suggests the largest that fits on this machine's card, else the smallest. The person may choose any model the runtime serves.

keyed.name: Anthropic, your own key
keyed.free: Not free: the player's own key pays Anthropic per token, at Anthropic's rates. Nothing passes through our servers.
keyed.data: Sent from the player's browser straight to Anthropic. An organization with zero data retention or the Compliance API on is refused browser calls.
keyed.browser: Allowed with the anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access header, which the door sets (platform.claude.com docs, read 2026-11-04).

keyed.name: Google Gemini API
keyed.free: Flash, Flash-Lite and Gemma models free of charge, within daily limits shown in AI Studio.
keyed.data: Free-tier content is used to improve Google products and may be read by people. Not free in the EEA, Switzerland or the UK. 18 and over.
keyed.browser: A browser preflight from another origin passed on 2026-11-04; the provider's docs do not say whether a page may call it.

keyed.name: Groq
keyed.free: A free plan with per-minute and per-day limits.
keyed.data: Not kept by default; may be logged up to 30 days for abuse checks. Held in the US.
